novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new measurement/protocol route, explicitly stating that "orphan features" can be separated into "genuine latent scientific signals" and "technical/dataset artifacts" using "external-modality predictivity, cross-dataset stability, and causal ablation specificity." The closest located prior work was "Learning biologically relevant features in a pathology foundation model using sparse autoencoders" (2024), which validates SAE features against biological concepts and out-of-domain data, while the claim's cited InterPLM and ICFL work similarly focuses on annotation matching; searches covered "SAE orphan features scientific foundation models," "sparse autoencoder feature validation cross-dataset stability," "SAE causal ablation biological features," and "prospective discovery unannotated latent features." The step from those works to this proposal is a substantive multi-criterion combination and operationalization of prospective orphan triage, rather than a direct transfer, but it does not introduce a broadly new causal measurement paradigm or a new scientific mechanism, so it merits standard-to-upper-standard novelty (6), not high novelty.
